styles.intent: Update your soft-wear. An evolution of our Scuba collection, this classic, close-fitting hoodie is cut from our new SuperLoft™ Light fabric and features signature ribbed panelling on the sides.

features.title: Product Features
details: Hand pockets, one with a hidden card sleeve
Thumbholes
Elastic zipper pull doubles as an emergency hair tie—remove it from the zipper and pull it out horizontally to snap it into a round elastic for your hair or your wrist
Improved two-sided zipper guard protects your chin against chafe
Two-way metal zipper
Thoughtful design details like discreet stitching, lined pockets, and refined construction give it a clean, elevated look

fabric.title: Luxuriously Soft Cotton-Blend SuperLoft™ Light Fabric
details: Brushed on both sides for luxurious softness
Naturally breathable
Cozy fleece interior
Has a compact, lofty feel and a lighter drape
Soft ribbed panels at the sides, hem, and cuffs

fit.title: Classic Fit, Hip Length
details: This classic fit floats away from your body and feels a touch roomier than our original Scuba Full-Zip Hoodie
Sits below the waistband for moderate, everyday coverage
